resume.name: Manju Krishna Haridas
resume.profile: Legal professional with an LL.M. in Business and Corporate Law (First Rank, Symbiosis International University) and hands-on experience in contract drafting, corporate law research, and law firm practice. Currently completing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised). Seeking to apply international legal expertise and a proactive work ethic within Extract via OpenClaw's team.

experience.title: Language Intern (Kieliharjoittelu)
bullets: Gained direct exposure to Finnish legal practice and procedures within a professional law firm environment.
Developed Finnish legal vocabulary and professional communication; produced legal correspondence in Finnish.
Observed contract review and client advisory processes, bridging international legal expertise with the Finnish system.

experience.title: Intern
bullets: Coordinated 14 community events (avg. 25 international participants each), managing logistics, communications, and stakeholder liaison.
Contributed to the deployment of the 'OuluBot' digital service: data training, 100+ pilot-user feedback reports.

experience.title: Legal Associate
bullets: Drafted, reviewed, and negotiated 5-7 commercial agreements per month (NDAs, service agreements, supply contracts) across four corporate clients.
Conducted in-depth legal research on company law and contract law; managed full contract lifecycle from initial drafting through execution and archiving.

experience.title: Junior Lawyer
bullets: Researched 50+ case laws for civil and family law trials; prepared legal memoranda and trial briefs; represented clients in court hearings.

paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the ViestintÃ¤assistentti position within Extract via OpenClaw's team. The opportunity to work across international contract law, IP, and privacy law at a globally recognised company is exactly the kind of environment I have been working towards – and I am confident my background makes me a strong fit.

I hold an LL.M. in Business and Corporate Law (First Rank, Symbiosis International University) and have practical experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts in a corporate legal practice. At Poise Legal in India, I managed the full lifecycle of 5-7 commercial agreements per month – NDAs, service agreements, and supply contracts – while conducting regulatory and company law research to support corporate clients. More recently, I completed a professional language placement at Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy in Oulu, where I worked directly within a Finnish law firm environment, developing my Finnish legal vocabulary and observing local legal processes first-hand.

I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), which directly reflects my commitment to integrating my international legal expertise with the Finnish legal system. I work comfortably and independently in both English and Finnish, and I approach both complex legal analysis and routine administrative tasks with the same attention to detail and proactive attitude.

Extract via OpenClaw's in-house model – working directly alongside the General Counsel and gaining exposure to corporate-level legal operations – is precisely the learning environment I am seeking. I am available for the September 2026 start and can commit to the part-time schedule during the academic year, transitioning to full-time over summer.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
